obs: “It seems to me that this statute must be taken to use its words in a strict and accurate sense. They would be absurd in any other.”
United Steelworkers v. National Labor Relations Board

"The substitution of violent coercion in place of peaceful persuasion would not in itself bring the complained-of conduct into conflict with 8 (b) (4). It is the object of union encouragement that is proscribed by that section, rather than the means adopted to make it felt."
National Labor Relations Board v. Enterprise Ass'n of Steam, Hot Water, Hydraulic Sprinkler, Pneumatic Tube, Ice Machine & General Pipefitters

"It is not necessary to find that the sole object of the strike was secondary so long as one of the unions objectives was to influence another employer by inducing the struck employer to cease doing business with that other employer."
We think it implausible, however, that Congress intended this meaning of "design." ... In addition, the structural meaning of "design" is both overinclusive and underinclusive
